about:
Integrated Cable Systems (ICS) operates from Longmont, Colorado, as a supplier of specialized cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and electro-mechanical assemblies. The company holds ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certifications and describes itself as a turn-key provider with decades of technical and manufacturing engineering experience.

ICS manufactures custom cable assemblies and wire harnesses, including discrete wire harnesses, complex routed harnesses, jacketed cable assemblies, molded cable assemblies, jumper cable assemblies, and SCSI and RJ45 cable assemblies. Its capabilities extend to MS connector and crimping applications, engineering consultation, development of customer documentation, and testing of custom interconnect products. The facility uses a Schleuniger PowerStrip 9580 automatic cut-and-strip machine for wires up to 70 mm² (2/0 AWG), shielded cables, and complex multiconductor applications, supporting cutting, stripping, and marking operations.

The company serves aerospace, defense, and medical industries. A noted project involved a manufacturer of image-guided therapy devices requiring cables with an exceptionally tight bend radius for a new laser product, delivered in partnership with Cicoil for high-flex flat cable and custom molded panel grommets.

ICS emphasizes its focus on high-cost-of-failure applications, combining deep expertise, relentless innovation, and customer focus to solve complex connectivity challenges. The company states its purpose is to deliver innovative connectivity solutions with uncompromising quality and continuous improvement.
